title: Infinite Worlds World v2.1
description: Schema for Infinite Worlds story world JSON files. Single source of truth — schema_model.SCHEMA_SUMMARY is derived from this document at import time. IW-specific metadata uses x-iw-* extensions, which jsonschema validators ignore.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this world conforms to. Read on every load, write on every save.

title.description: World title shown to authors and players.

background.description: Background lore and setting sent to the AI as context.

instructions.description: Main instructions sent to the AI on every turn.

authorStyle.description: Style guidance for prose generated by the AI.

firstInput.description: Hidden turn-0 prompt that seeds the opening of the story.

objective.description: Stated objective shown to the player.

mature.description: Marks the world as containing mature content.

nsfw.description: Marks the world as containing NSFW content. Requires mature: true.

contentWarnings.description: Content warnings shown to the player before starting.

descriptionRequest.description: Prompt used when the AI generates scene descriptions.

evaluationRequest.description: Prompt used when the AI evaluates player actions.

summaryRequest.description: Prompt used when the AI summarizes the story.

hideSkillSystem.description: When true, hides the world's skill values from the player UI.

imageStyle.description: Image style preset identifier. Null is tolerated but not recommended; prefer a string value.

imageStyleCharacterPre.description: Legacy: prefix text appended to character image prompts.

imageStyleCharacterPost.description: Legacy: suffix text appended to character image prompts.

imageStyleNonCharacterPre.description: Legacy: prefix text appended to non-character image prompts.

imageStyleNonCharacterPost.description: Legacy: suffix text appended to non-character image prompts.

illustrationStyleCharacterLowPriority.description: Low-priority illustration style hint for character images. Coexistence with legacy imageStyle* fields is an open question.

illustrationStyleCharacterHighPriority.description: High-priority illustration style hint for character images.

illustrationStyleNonCharacterLowPriority.description: Low-priority illustration style hint for non-character images.

illustrationStyleNonCharacterHighPriorit.description: High-priority illustration style hint for non-character images.

enableAISpecificInstructionBlocks.description: Enables AI-profile-specific gating on instruction blocks.

recommendedAIModel.description: Recommended AI model identifier. Enum of valid values is an open question; fixture currently only shows null.

charSelectText.description: Text shown on the character-selection screen.

designNotes.description: Author notes about the world's design. NOT sent to the AI.

skills.description: List of skill names available in this world.

autoAdvanceVersion.description: When true, the platform auto-increments version on save.

previewImage.description: URL of the preview image shown in the world list.

fullSizePreviewImage.description: URL of the full-size preview image.

fullSizePreviewImageOptions.description: Available full-size preview image URL options.

currentPreviewImageIndex.description: Index of the currently selected preview image.

allowChangeCharacterName.description: Allows the player to change their character's name.

allowChangeCharacterDescription.description: Allows the player to change their character's description.

allowChangeCharacterSkills.description: Allows the player to change their character's skill values.

allowChangeCharacterItemValues.description: Allows the player to change their character's initial tracked-item values.

allowChangeCharacterPortrait.description: Allows the player to change their character's portrait.

allowChangeCharacterNewPortrait.description: Allows the player to generate a new portrait at runtime.

permissionsOnceShared.description: Permissions granted to other users once this world is shared.

sharing.description: Other users can re-share this world.

editing.description: Other users can edit this world. Requires sharing: true.

victoryCondition.description: Optional victory condition for the world.

defeatCondition.description: Optional defeat condition for the world.

imagePromptDetails.description: Default image prompt details for the world.

NPCs.description: Non-player characters available in the world.

trackedItems.description: World state variables tracked across turns.

triggerEvents.description: Conditional events that fire when their conditions are met.

text.description: Message shown to the player when triggered.

alreadyFired.description: Platform runtime state — do not set in authored worlds.

imagePromptDetails.description: Structured image-prompt fields used by the platform's image generator.

illustrIsCharacter.description: Whether the subject is a character.

initialTrackedItemValue.description: Per-character override for a tracked item's initial value.

description.description: Character description visible to the player.

skills.description: Map of skill name → numeric value. Keys must match world-level skills.

initialTrackedItemValues.description: Per-character initial values for tracked items.

positionInList.description: Ordering position in the NPC list.

detail.description: Detailed description sent to the AI.

location.description: NPC's typical location in the world.

secret_info.description: Information the NPC keeps secret from the player.

names.description: Alternative names the NPC may go by.

name.description: Display name (used for snake_case template variable).

positionInList.description: Ordering position in the tracked items list.

description.description: Authoring description of what this variable represents.

updateInstructions.description: Instructions for how the AI should update this value.

autoUpdate.description: Whether the AI updates this variable automatically each turn.

triggerEvent.description: Conditional event that fires when conditions are met

canTriggerMoreThanOnce.description: Whether the trigger can fire more than once.

triggerConditions.description: Conditions that must be true for the trigger to fire.

triggerEffects.description: Effects to apply when the trigger fires.

triggerCondition.description: Condition shape — lenient on `data` because polymorphic shape depends on `type`. The x-iw-condition-types registry below describes each type's data shape; Tier 2 validation enforces it.

data.description: Polymorphic payload whose shape depends on `type`. See x-iw-condition-types.

triggerOnCharacter.description: Fires only for specific player characters

triggerOnTrackedItem.description: Fires based on tracked item or skill value comparison

triggerOnRandomChance.description: Fires with a random probability each turn

triggerOnTurn.description: Fires when current turn >= data value

triggerOnEvent.description: AI-evaluated: fires when AI judges the described event occurred

triggerPrereqs.data: string[] (trigger IDs that must have fired)

triggerBlockers.data: string[] (trigger IDs that must NOT have fired)
triggerBlockers.description: Blocked if any listed trigger has fired

logic.description: Combinator — requires advancedLogic: true on the trigger

triggerEffect.description: Effect shape — lenient on `data` because polymorphic shape depends on `type`. The x-iw-effect-types registry below describes each type's data shape; Tier 2 validation enforces it.

data.description: Polymorphic payload whose shape depends on `type`. See x-iw-effect-types.

effectTellAIWhatToDo.description: Directive to the AI for next turn

effectGiveInfo.description: Append to secretInfo (not guaranteed to be followed)

effectChangeVictoryCondition.description: Replace victory condition (alreadyFired must be false)

effectChangeDefeatCondition.description: Replace defeat condition (alreadyFired must be false)

effectEndsGame.description: End the game. data: true allows the player to continue playing (victory-style); data: false ends with no continuation (defeat-style). Pre-v2.1 worlds used a separate canContinueEndedGame field; in v2.1 that semantic is consolidated into this data boolean.

effectModifyInstructionBlock.description: Modify an instruction block by ID

effectModifyKeywordBlock.description: Modify a lore book entry by ID (replaces both content and keywords)

effectSetTrackedItemValue.description: Set or modify a tracked item's value

effectModifyTrackedItemDetails.data: {trackedItemID, overrideName, overrideDescription, overrideUpdateInstructions, overrideVisibility, overrideAutoUpdate, name?, description?, updateInstructions?, visibility?, autoUpdate?}
effectModifyTrackedItemDetails.description: Modify tracked item metadata (not its value)

effectPresentChoice.data: {choices, message, updateMode, maxSelections, minSelections, selectionMode, valueDelimiter, targetTrackedItemId}
effectPresentChoice.description: Present player a choice; result saved to tracked item (blocking)

selectedAIProfiles.description: AI profiles for which this block is active. Only relevant when enableAISpecificInstructionBlocks is true.

keywords.description: Keywords that activate this lore entry.

x-iw-template-variables.initial: initial_<varname> — initial value of any numerical variable
